posts.title: Feeling Sixteen Again
posts.description: Last night, I went to see a band. I was a little nervous about it. It was my first time going to see a band in my new city. I've never been to the bar, there was no easy parking around, and I didn't know what the crowd would be like. posts.title: Why Are You Shooting me!?
posts.description: I started playing Minishoot Adventures today. I haven't played a twin-stick shooter in a long time, but it didn't take long to remember how they feel. The controls are smooth and easy. Initially, you're alone in this world until you fly around and encounter another machine. "Are you friend?" I wondered. It came closer to my plane and I let it.
